class.name: easynav_controller/DummyController
class.description: A default "dummy" implementation for the Controller Method. This control method does nothing. It serves as an example, and will be used as a default plugin implementation if the navigation system configuration does not specify one.

class.name: easynav_controller/FaultyController
class.description: Controller that injects faults (throw, hang, stop proposing, freeze, huge or NaN velocities), to test how EasyNav copes with them.
